description: Found by the 14.10 two-part spike (agent ae159c1). Part 1's addressed-alpha convergence collapse (list->list(a_e), callable->address_var) makes the recursive activation KEY non-idempotent across sites: SealSemanticClosure waits on an activation key that the analyzer never settles (seal-side key != analyzer-concluded key), so 6 enum-reduce-multi-surface activations stall (pending=0, Settled(Activation) waited-on, SemanticClosed never seals). The address-var branches change what activation_key/canonical_activation_key produces depending on the path frame; re-canonicalizing an already-address-var key (or the seal recomputing it) yields a different key. NOTE realpha_inputs (the key re-canonicalizer) was deleted. FIX: make the addressed convergence collapse produce a CANONICAL key that round-trips identically wherever the key is (re)computed (analyze, seal, flow edges) — idempotent under re-addressing. This is the frontier-side prerequisite for the addressed-key arc; blocks landing fz-f98.14.10.2 (addressed convergence) and thus the whole family. Transport keystone (P2) is independently sound.

comments.text: FULLY MAPPED (spike agent a8f27e8 + isolation follow-up). DIVERGENCE (rendered, FunctionId(185) reduce_while/take reducer): analyzer key has variant-union element address a1_1_0_e; the seal waits on a1_u0_1_0_e (spurious Variant(u0) step) -> never matches -> SemanticClosed never seals -> 6 enum-reduce-multi-surface stalls. ROOT: an ADDRESSING INCONSISTENCY between P1's convergence_class_at (walks pure_tuple with Field(j) ONLY, no Variant step) and the canonical address_remap (inserts Variant(k) for >1-alternative tuples via discriminate_tuple_alternatives). define_callsite_summary (world.rs:1085) realpha_inputs re-addresses the convergence key; address_vars_at re-mints the existing var in the Variant-aware frame -> a1_1_0_e drifts to a1_u0_1_0_e. TWO FIXES: (A, tested) make address_remap PRESERVE existing ADDRESS_TAG vars (don't re-address) -> both sides a1_1_0_e, clears 5/6 stalls -- BUT a1_1_0_e is NON-CANONICAL (lacks the Variant disambiguator) and transport derives layout expecting the canonical Variant-aware address, so (A) is a paper-over that interacts badly with the enum-reduce transport path. (B, UNTESTED, likely-correct) make convergence_class_at address tuple variants the SAME way address_remap does (insert the Variant step) -> both sides a1_u0_1_0_e, canonical + transport-consistent, no re-addressing disabled. TEST (B) NEXT. RESIDUAL after the stall clears: a SEPARATE transport-shape problem (non-recursive FunctionId(68): 4 evidence-distinct executables [Ty32,Ty93/316/336/966] forced into one position-component -> flaky transport.rs:338 shape-anchor; HashMap-iteration nondeterminism). NOTE: branch HEAD moved to d42413dfa (fz-5md 'park waiters until full wait set satisfies'), which itself perturbed the enum-reduce family (take_positive + enum_reduce_runtime_graph now fail at HEAD in isolation) — re-baseline before measuring.

STALE — re-baseline required. The mapped mechanism (seal-key drifts a1_1_0_e->a1_u0_1_0_e because define_callsite_summary calls realpha_inputs to re-address the key) was CORRECT for the spike's base 92d57c0d1 (realpha live there; define_callsite_summary called activation.realpha_inputs). But commit dc6e737e2 ('Tweaks') REMOVED realpha_inputs entirely (grep: none in src/; identity.rs ActivationKey impl has only from_inputs/inputs/input_len; world.rs:1085 is now a COMMENT documenting the removal, re-addressing only surface_inputs). Current HEAD d42413dfa has NO realpha. So at HEAD nothing re-addresses the activation key at the callsite seam -> the seal waits on the same un-re-addressed key the analyzer produced -> the frontier divergence this ticket maps is likely ALREADY DISSOLVED by dc6e737e2. Fix-A (address_remap idempotency guard) and fix-B (Variant-aware convergence_class_at) both solved the realpha-drift, which no longer exists. RE-VERIFY: re-apply P1 (addressed-alpha convergence) on current HEAD (no realpha) and check whether the 6 enum-reduce stalls reproduce at all. If not, 14.10.3 is moot and the only remaining 14.10 blocker is the transport-shape residual (fn-68 evidence-distinct executables, transport.rs:338).

title: Addressed-collapse activation key must be frontier-consistent (seal-side key == analyzer-side key; idempotent re-canonicalization)
